our_interpretation: The condition means a post-publication trade in Nasdaq-listed ARM below US$80 per depositary share, including an intraday trade.

In the surrounding financing discussion, 'get hairy' means material pressure on SoftBank's ARM-backed financing, such as a margin call, compulsory repayment, additional collateral demand, or forced asset sale attributable to the price fall.
No deadline is stated. A lower share valuation alone is not sufficient evidence of the predicted financing pressure.
criteria.support_condition: After ARM trades below $80 following publication, dated records establish material financing pressure attributable to the fall under SoftBank's ARM-backed borrowing arrangements.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the condition occurs, applicable loan terms and completed collateral tests establish that the below-$80 episode did not cause material financing pressure. Mere silence or the passage of time is insufficient.
